name: configuration-secrets
summary: Manage application configuration as explicit project/environment state. Detect missing variables, keep secrets outside model-visible context, request human credentials through the Configuration UI, verify connections, and block production readiness when required configuration is missing.
guidelines: Discover configuration requirements before deployment instead of learning about missing values from production failures.
Never ask the user to paste passwords, API keys, tokens, or client secrets into chat. Use configuration_require so the local Configuration UI requests them.
The model may set non-secret defaults/configuration through configuration_set, but secret values must enter through the trusted UI boundary.
Use typed connection tests for SMTP, AI providers and databases after credentials are supplied.
Treat development, staging and production as separate configuration environments.
Do not claim a dependency is ready merely because a variable exists; connection-test it when a supported tester is available.
definition_of_done: All required production variables are configured.
Secret values have not appeared in model-visible output, tool arguments, Git, or logs.
Relevant supported external service connections have been tested.
Materialized .env files are local/protected and excluded from Git.
Production readiness reports no configuration blocker.
